messages:
riley: Heads-up: our emulator soak shows sporadic duplicate requests and stalled queueing when using Retrofit + OkHttp on API 30. Suspect a race between coroutine cancellation and OkHttp Dispatcher maxRequests.

nora: Hmm. Do you have logs for dispatcher stats? If maxRequests is reached and cancellation doesn't free up the dispatcher slot quickly, new enqueues can block and clients may retry.

riley: Minimal repro: fire 50 short POSTs through our SDK with a per-call retry interceptor. Cancel many coroutines midway (simulate activity destroy). Later resume network: server reports duplicate POSTs ~20% of runs. Logs:

```
I/OkHttp: Dispatcher.runningCalls=8 queuedCalls=12
W/Coroutine: job cancelled for request id=xyz
I/RetryInterceptor: retrying request id=xyz attempt=1
I/OkHttp: Enqueued call for id=xyz (queued)
I/Server: Received POST id=xyz
I/Server: Received POST id=xyz
```

ash: That shows retry interceptor retried while the cancelled call was still queued. If cancellation doesn't remove the queued call from Dispatcher, retry will create a new call and you get duplicates.

nora: Two mitigations: 1) have the retry interceptor check call.isCanceled() before retrying, 2) on coroutine cancellation remove the call from dispatcher queue if possible (call.cancel() sometimes only marks it, not dequeue). OkHttp doesn't expose a public dequeue API though.

riley: Tried call.cancel in invokeOnCancellation but still saw queued entries. The queued call can be in a window before enqueue -> it gets enqueued but cancellation races.

ash: We ended up doing a small change in SDK: (a) make retry interceptor check call.isExecuted() and call.isCanceled() before any retry attempt, and (b) mark a local volatile flag on cancellation that suppresses scheduling retries and ignores late responses. Also added integration test that rapidly cancels jobs while hitting rate limits.

nora: Addendum: document that users should prefer synchronous call.cancel path in invokeOnCancellation to avoid races and avoid combining coroutine timeouts with interceptor-driven retries. Also added a sample in devex/samples/android/retrofit-cancel-race showing the bad vs good pattern.

android-ci-bot: Patch branch 2719 built on android-integration-tests (artifact: 8.6.2-beta) :white_check_mark:

riley: Great. Follow-ups: @ash push retry-safeguards PR, @nora add sample + README, I'll schedule a canary build to Dedicated mobile. We'll keep an eye on emulator soak for duplicates. :thumbsup:
